tasks.title: Audit and Fix All Failing Tests
tasks.description: Run the full test suite using `npm test` to identify all failing tests. Read each failing test file and investigate the root cause of failures. Fix issues such as: incorrect imports, outdated test assertions, missing mocks, improper async handling, or incorrect component props. Test files to audit: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx. Also check vite.config.ts and src/test/setup.ts for any test configuration issues. Ensure all tests pass locally by running the full suite before completing this task.
acceptance_criteria: All test files execute without errors
No skipped or failing tests in the suite
Test suite completes successfully with 100% pass rate
All test files follow consistent patterns and conventions

tasks.title: Validate Complete Test Suite Passes
tasks.description: Run the complete test suite using `npm test` and verify all tests pass without failures or errors. Confirm that all test files execute successfully: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx. Check test output for any warnings or issues that need attention.
acceptance_criteria: All tests pass with zero failures
No skipped tests unless intentionally marked
